checks.observed: Eight static-site tests pass for all 253 indexable pages, complete workflow instructions, canonical/hreflang, source links, sitemap, structured data, safe rendering and repeatable builds. Old published content-hashed assets are retained for cached pages and open tabs.
checks.limits: Preserved crawlable content and metadata do not establish search ranking or indexing results.
